newsitem.title: POLAND: Creditanstalt unit wants to advise Polish Nafta.
newsitem.headline: Creditanstalt unit wants to advise Polish Nafta.

text.p: Creditanstalt Financial Advisers SA (CAFA) seeks to advise Polish oil holding Nafta Polska SA on its privatisation, CAFA's director for capital raising said on Monday.
"We are taking part in the tender for adviser on the privatisation of Nafta Polska," Jerzy Gumowski told a news conference. Potential advisers have until Monday to submit offers.
Nafta, which is supervising the modernisation and privatisation of Poland's oil sector, has said it would likely pick an adviser on the sell-off of two refineries by May's end.
It has said about 25 investment banks and consulting firms should bid in the tender for adviser.
Earlier this month it said 10 foreign firms had signalled interest in stakes of the two refineries, Poland's largest.
Under the government privatisation scheme, Nafta Polska will offer up to 30 percent of shares in the two refineries to strategic investors, possibly this year.
Gumowski told Reuters the refinery stakes might not be sold until early next year.
